high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the verified Twitter account of Ram Gopal Varma (@RGVzoomin). The tweet discusses a fictional scenario involving a lawyer turned gangster who seeks revenge for the death of a deer by targeting a superstar. The gangster, who has recruited 700 members through Facebook, plans to kill a big politician who is a close friend of the superstar as a warning. The tweet also mentions that the police cannot catch the gangster because he is under government protection in jail, with his spokesman speaking from abroad.
